name: little-sleepies-systems-poc
description: Airtable <-> n8n <-> ERPNext (NetSuite stand-in) <-> Postgres (Snowflake stand-in) integration POC

scripts.test:py: docker compose --profile tools run --rm tools python -m pytest -q
scripts.n8n:import: node n8n/generate-credentials.mjs | docker compose exec -T n8n sh -c "cat > /tmp/creds.json && n8n import:credentials --input=/tmp/creds.json; rc=$?; rm -f /tmp/creds.json; exit $rc" && docker compose exec n8n n8n import:workflow --separate --input=/workflows
scripts.n8n:export: docker compose exec n8n n8n export:workflow --all --separate --output=/home/node/.n8n/exports
